g.title: schedule
g.text: M-FSDP v2 + PP2/VPP2 interleaved 1F1B + MoE EP overlap
World=8, TP=1, PP=2, VPP=2, EP=2, dense DP=4, expert DP=2, MBS=1, GBS=16 => M=4

g.title: topology
g.text: Logical virtual-pipeline path for each microbatch
Backward traverses VS3 → VS2 → VS1 → VS0. Physically, a microbatch visits P0 → P1 → P0 → P1.

g.title: lookup
g.text: VPP lookup table (microbatch group size defaults to PP = 2)

g.title: p0
g.text: Physical PP rank P0: local scheduler order

g.title: p1
g.text: Physical PP rank P1: local scheduler order

g.title: caveat
g.text: each row is exact local scheduler-call order. Columns in P0 and P1 are not a shared, cycle-accurate clock; pipeline dependencies and P2P communication determine their physical alignment.

g.title: chunk
g.text: Inside one purple combined step: model-chunk schedule (four layers per chunk)

g.title: streams
g.text: The two rows execute on separate CUDA streams; event dependencies preserve dataflow while EP all-to-all overlaps compute.

g.title: fsdp
g.text: M-FSDP v2 lifecycle around each scheduled layer
Dense groups shard over DP=4; expert groups shard over expert-DP=2. Main gradients are accumulated in FP32 by this recipe.

g.title: note
g.text: , so do not interpret the diagram as enabling Megatron's optional asynchronous PP-P2P mode.
